Sources.Observation: The publisher lists 5.1.1, released 2026-09-23, as its latest release on the reviewed page. No newer fixed release is listed there.

A 2026-09-23 report says the /C INI component controls remain broken in 5.1.1. The reporter traced the behavior to config_fetch_bool returning through SetUserVariableA with incorrect WCHAR pointer arithmetic, causing false component settings to be ignored or misassigned.
Documents /S, /C=<ini> and /D=<path>; it does not document a supported workaround for the reported v5 component-control defect.

ObservedRIDEFailure.SelectedConfiguration: Per-user Gpg4win installation with a /C INI intended to install GnuPG and Kleopatra only.
ObservedRIDEFailure.Assessment: The upstream component-control defect is relevant to the selected installation method, but available guest evidence does not identify the module or prove that it caused this access violation.

Disposition.MigrationBlockedOn: Technical validation of the selected per-user component configuration and a successful install/remove/recovery path.
Disposition.NextAction: Do not promote or repeat the same 5.1.1 /C component configuration as an expected passing acceptance. Revisit after a publisher fix or a separately documented and independently tested workaround that preserves the user-approved per-user scope and selected components.
Disposition.RejectedWorkaround: The forum-mentioned HKLM uninstall-key preseed is not adopted; it changes machine-scope state and is not established for this per-user package operation.
Disposition.ExcludedTools: Defender-detected tools remain separate exclusions and are unrelated to Gpg4win.
